steps.title: A new 'how much can this hurt' card
steps.narration: Every stock's detail page now includes a Risk budget card that spells out, in plain percentages, how much a name could realistically hurt you.
steps.point_out: Below the Themes and Invalidation section, six tiles show ATR%, downside volatility, the worst historical 20-day drop, distance to the invalidation level, and an overnight-gap profile — each compared against the rest of the universe.

steps.title: The same risk measures, ranked market-wide
steps.narration: The stocks leaderboard now carries five new sortable risk columns, so you can rank the entire universe by risk exposure, not just by opportunity score.
steps.point_out: Scroll right past 'Proximity to 52w high' to see the new ATR%, Downside vol, Gap p95, Worst 20d, and Dist. to invalidation columns, each showing a real number or an honest 'NA'.

steps.title: Sort by risk, not just by score
steps.narration: Clicking a risk column header re-ranks every stock by that measure, and names without enough history to compute it honestly sink to the bottom instead of being hidden.
steps.point_out: Watch the row order change and a sort arrow appear next to 'Worst 20d'.

steps.title: Definitions built right into the table
steps.narration: Every new risk column carries its own info icon, so anyone can check exactly how a measure is defined without leaving the leaderboard.
steps.point_out: The popup names the metric, explains it in plain language, and states the exact lookback window it's computed over.

steps.title: A glossary that keeps up with new metrics
steps.narration: The methodology page's glossary now documents every new risk term — its formula and the exact time window it uses — right alongside the site's existing definitions.
steps.point_out: The 'Factor Lab & Statistics' category gains three new entries; no new category was needed.

steps.title: Searching for a new term
steps.narration: Typing a new risk term into the glossary's search box instantly narrows the list to the one matching definition — the same search box that already covers every other term on the site.
steps.point_out: The single matching result, 'distance-to-invalidation %', appears with its plain-language definition.

steps.title: Scores stay exactly as they were
steps.narration: Back on a stock's detail page, the Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk scores — and their honest 'Not yet proven' badges — look exactly as they did before the new card arrived.
steps.point_out: Nothing about the existing scores or evidence badges changed; the new risk card lives entirely on its own, higher up the page.

steps.title: Deep price history still works
steps.narration: Further down the same page, the price chart still expands to a stock's full trading history at the click of a button, undisturbed by the new card above it.
steps.point_out: The chart redraws with a longer bar count and an updated 'as of' caption.
